Bank’s vast distribution network (Branches,
Agents, Merchants, ATMs). The Bank
leverages innovative delivery models to co-
create enrolment and payment solutions
for Elderly Persons, Orphans, Persons with
Severe Disabilities, Persons living in ASALs,
Internally Displaced Persons, Refugees, and
